title: Record page related tab: the enlarged table has no record name — a rep sees five amounts and cannot tell which deal is which
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「1 同意立卡」 (2026-11-04), after asking for a demonstration of this defect.

Filed by the record-page epic seat from a browser evaluation of the Console on `main` `63b86b385d` (example CRM, zh-CN, dev admin). An independent reviewer ran the pass and the seat re-checked the evidence named below. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

A rep opens a customer and clicks the 商机 tab to see that customer's deals. The table lists amounts, dates and probabilities with no deal name. Five rows read ¥120,000, ¥75,000, ¥12,400, ¥60,000, ¥90,000, and nothing says which deal each one is. The only link in the row is the amount, so a person has to click amounts to find a deal. This is the default record page, so it reaches every object with a related list and every record visit that uses the tab.

## Reproduce

1. Run `examples/app-crm` and open a customer with deals, for example Acme Corp: `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_account/record/{id}?related=crm_opportunity.account`.
2. Read the table.

Measured in the browser by the seat:

| Tab | Headers on screen |
|:--|:--|
| 商机 on a customer | #, 金额, 预计成交日期, 赢单概率 (%), 操作 |
| 活动 on an opportunity | #, 活动类型, 截止日期, 联系人, 客户, 操作 |

The reviewer also read 联系人 on a customer as #, 邮箱, 操作. The first row's link text is `¥120,000.00` and its target is the opportunity record. The server returns `name` for these rows (`Acme — Q3 Platform Renewal → 120000`), and the compact panel on 概览 draws the same names.

## Code readings on `63b86b385d`

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:2374-2383`: with no declared columns, the columns come from the child object's `highlightFields`, then pass the FK, field-security and empty pruning. Nothing adds the name.
- `:2838-2843`: the enlarged face hands the grid `effectiveColumns` only.
- `examples/app-crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts:19`: `highlightFields: ['account', 'amount', 'close_date', 'probability']`, which is right for the highlight strip (#28868).

`highlightFields` means "what to feature beside the title", so it never lists the title. Two landings met here on 2026-11-02: `9a9823d921` declared the strips and `a36409337b` (#28902) moved the enlarged tab to the list grid. Whether the columns held a name before those two is not measured.

This misses #28865's acceptance line "The name is a link to the record", on a card closed as completed.

## Acceptance

1. With no columns declared for the relation, the enlarged table's first data column is the child record's name, resolved the way the platform names a record (`nameField` / `titleFormat`, ADR-0079), and it links to the record.
2. The highlight fields still follow it, without repeating the name.
3. Columns an author declared on the relation are honoured as declared.
4. A test pins this on a child object whose `highlightFields` omit the name.
5. A browser check of 商机, 活动 and 联系人 on the example CRM, with a screenshot on the PR.

## Not in this card

The highlight strip, the compact panels, and any change to what `highlightFields` means.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "declaredHighlights" origin/main -- ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`
